title: fluffy red stuff
description: the mod adds fluffy red stuff that can fall.
body:
This mod adds a new red falling block called Fluffy. It is a simple block, but it has its own fun idea and can be used for building, testing, or just adding something different into the game. Fluffy is a red block that falls like sand or gravel, which makes it a little more interesting than a normal block. Because it falls, you can use it in creative ways for decoration, traps, or just experimenting in your world.

This was a small project I made while working on custom Minecraft content. It is not a huge mod, but it is one of the custom things I created while learning and practicing how to make my own blocks. If you like trying simple mods with unique little ideas, then this is something you might enjoy adding to your game.
